questions.question: State the three main components of Atkinson and Shiffrin’s multi‑store model of memory.
Explain how maintenance rehearsal influences the transfer of information from short‑term memory to long‑term memory in the multi‑store model.
Describe the serial position effect and give an example of a study that demonstrates this effect.
Evaluate the evidence that supports the existence of a separate sensory register in the multi‑store model.
State the main components of Baddeley and Hitch’s working memory model.
Explain the role of the central executive in the working memory model and give an example of a task that would engage it.
Compare the phonological loop and the visuospatial sketchpad in terms of their function and capacity.
Describe an experiment that provides evidence for the existence of the episodic buffer and evaluate its strengths and weaknesses.
Define episodic, semantic and procedural memory and give an example of each.
Evaluate the differences between episodic and semantic memory in terms of content, retrieval cues and typical age of onset.
